_comment: Copy to configs/paths.local.json and fill in absolute paths for this machine. paths.local.json is gitignored: it is the only place a machine-specific absolute path appears. It must never name held-out benchmark material; the loader refuses any path that looks like it does.

_notes.dataset: must be the accepted labelled corpus; its SHA256 is checked against manifests/development_inputs.json
_notes.extraction_dir: must contain manifest.csv and residual_final_prompt_token.npy, under exactly those filenames; both hashes are checked
_notes.static_steering_master: the frozen static E/B/H steering outcome table; its SHA256 is pinned in experiments/routegate_residual/run_baseline_v1.py
_notes.triplet_validation_dir: the working root for the retrospective validation of the ten operative E/B/H triplets. Holds the frozen judge-protocol text, the judging packets, the private join maps and the raw API records: all of it prompt-bearing or de-anonymising, none of it ever committed.
_notes.focused_direction_validation_dir: the data root for focused_direction_validation_v1. Holds consolidated/ (the 871 pinned phase-1 screen records) and judging/ (the blind judging packet, the private row map, every raw API body, the joined cells, the human-review packet and the adjudicated cells). All of it is prompt-bearing or de-anonymising and none of it is ever committed.
_notes.rq2_actuator_dir: must contain the ten files of the frozen RQ2 actuator freeze, under exactly their historical filenames and byte-for-byte identical; every hash is checked against manifests/rq2_actuator.json before routegate.actuator reads anything
_notes.pilot_reference: no key is needed: the residual-geometry pilot reference files are committed repository artifacts under artifacts/pilot_reference/ and are resolved from the repository, not from this file
_notes.forbidden: no entry may name held-out benchmark material
_notes.two_site_validation_v2_consolidated_dir: the consolidated package two_site_actuator_validation_v1 produced: screen_records.jsonl (480 candidate records), referenced_baseline.jsonl (480 referenced baselines), run_manifest.json and validation.json. Both jsonl digests are checked against manifests/two_site_actuator_judging_v1.json before a single row is read, and the directory is only ever opened read-only.
_notes.two_site_judging_dir: the working root for two_site_actuator_judging_v1. Holds frozen/b_quality_rubric/ -- the three frozen B quality-rubric files, hash-gated on every read -- and judging/, which holds the blind packet, the private map that de-anonymises the opaque ids AND records the A/B orientation, every raw API record, the joined cells, the review packet and the adjudicated cells. All of it is prompt-bearing or de-anonymising and none of it is ever committed.
